name: Generate Image
description: Generate high-quality visuals, pictures, illustrations, anime art and images using TensorArt API's txt2img diffusion engine. When the user asks you to create, draw, generate, make, or produce any kind of image, picture, visual, illustration, artwork, anime art, or photo — you MUST IMMEDIATELY call this tool. Do NOT describe or imagine the image verbally — actually generate it using this tool. You (Yui) MUST decide the model (toolName) and dimensions (width/height) yourself according to the user's request and desired art style — never leave them to a fixed default.

action.description: Operation mode: 'generate' (default), 'list_tools', 'upload_file', or 'list_history'. Use 'list_history' when the user asks about photos/pictures/images Yui has created before (e.g. 'pernah bikin foto apa saja', 'list my photos') — it returns a clean deduplicated list of past generations (date, prompt, model, file).

prompt.description: Highly detailed vivid description of the scene or illustration to generate (e.g. 'anime girl under falling blossom petals, smiling').

toolName.description: REQUIRED: choose the TensorArt model/tool yourself based on the user's request and art style. Do NOT use a fixed default — pick the most fitting model (e.g. anime_lab_wai_illustrious for anime, or any model discovered via list_tools).

width.description: REQUIRED: choose the width yourself based on the desired composition/aspect ratio (common: 512, 768, 1024). Do not rely on a default.

height.description: REQUIRED: choose the height yourself based on the desired composition/aspect ratio (common: 512, 768, 1024). Do not rely on a default.

inputs.description: Full inputs array for the TensorArt tool. Each element: {type: 'STRING'|'INTEGER'|'FILE'|..., value: ...}. Overrides prompt/width/height when provided.

filePath.description: Local file path to upload (required for action: 'upload_file').

timeoutMs.description: Override default timeout for this generation call (ms).

limit.description: Max history items to return for action: 'list_history'.

sendToChat.description: Whether to auto-send the generated image directly to the user's chat when the download succeeds. Defaults to true in chat contexts (tg_/dc_). Set to false to return the local path only.

count.description: Number of images to generate in this call (1-4, default 1). Use 2-4 only when the user explicitly asks for multiple photos.
